blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.return` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method retrieves a list of returns. It sends a request to the
[List Returns](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#returns\_getreturns)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Filters and pagination configurations.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

children.name: limit
children.description: The maximum number of items to retrieve.

children.name: offset
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: order
children.description: The field to sort by and in which order.

children.name: with_deleted
children.description: Whether to include soft-deleted items in the results.

children.name: id
children.description: Filter by return ID(s).

children.name: order_id
children.description: Filter by order ID(s) to retrieve their returns.

children.name: status
children.description: Filter by status.

children.name: created_at
children.description: Filter by the date when the return was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: Filter by the date when the return was updated.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:

blocks.html:
This method updates an item in a return request by the ID of the item's `RETURN_ITEM` action.
Every item has an `actions` property, whose value is an array of actions. You can check the action's name 
using its `action` property, and use the value of the `id` property. For example, 
`item.actions.find((action) => action.action === "RETURN_ITEM")?.id` is the ID of an item's `RETURN_ITEM` action.

This method sends a request to the
[Update Requested Return Item](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#returns\_postreturnsidrequestitemsaction\_id)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the return to update the item in.

types.name: actionId
types.description: The ID of the item's `RETURN_ITEM` action.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the item to update.

children.name: quantity
children.description: The quantity of the item to return.

children.name: internal_note
children.description:
A note that is viewed by admins only to
describe why the item is being returned.

children.name: reason_id
children.description: The ID of the return reason to associate with the item.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the return item.

blocks.html:
This method updates a received item in the return by the ID of the item's `RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM` action.

Every item has an `actions` property, whose value is an array of actions. You can check the action's name 
using its `action` property, and use the value of the `id` property.

For example, `received_item.actions.find((action) => action.action === "RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM")?.id` is 
the ID of a received item's `RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM` action.

This method sends a request to the
[Update Received Item](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#returns\_postreturnsidreceiveitemsaction\_id)
API route.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the return to update the received item in.

types.name: actionId
types.description: The ID of the received item's `RECEIVE_RETURN_ITEM` action.

types.name: body
types.description: The details of the received item to update.

children.name: quantity
children.description: The received quantity of the item.

children.name: internal_note
children.description:
A note that is viewed by admins only to
describe the received item.

children.name: reason_id
children.description: The ID of the return reason to associate with the item.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the received item.

This method adds damaged items to the return. These items will have the action `RECEIVE_DAMAGED_RETURN_ITEM`.

A damaged item's quantity is not added back to the associated inventory item's quantity in the
stock location where the return is initiated from.

The method sends a request to the
[Add Damaged Items](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#returns\_postreturnsiddismissitems)
API route.
